command: mkdir -p .agents/logs && if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node {harness-dir}/playwright-mcp-wrapper.js docker run --rm -i mcp/playwright 2>>.agents/logs/playwright-mcp.log; else exec node {harness-dir}/playwright-mcp-wrapper.js npx -y @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 --browser chromium 2>>.agents/logs/playwright-mcp.log; fi
